manifest.title: Create a change event
manifest.description: Document a potential scope, cost, or schedule change as a change event with priced line items, recording the workflow as screenshots, Markdown, and manifest data.

steps.expected: The Create Change Event form opens.
steps.instruction: Select the project, open Change Events from the sidebar, and start a new change event to open the Create Change Event form.
steps.title: Open the new change event form

steps.expected: The change event is identified with a title, description, type, reason, and scope.
steps.instruction: Under General Information, leave Number to auto-generate (or set it), then enter a Title and Description that clearly identify the change. Set the Type, Change Reason, and Scope.
steps.title: Fill in the general information

steps.expected: The change event records where the change originated.
steps.instruction: Choose the Origin and, if applicable, the Origin Record to tie the change event back to its source (for example a related record).
steps.title: Set the origin

steps.expected: Revenue handling and markup basis are configured for the line items.
steps.instruction: Set Expecting Revenue and, when revenue is expected, the Line Item Revenue Source. If you are using markup, set the Prime Contract (markup basis) so markup is calculated against the right contract.
steps.title: Set revenue handling

steps.expected: Each line item has a budget code and pricing, and the total estimated value rolls up to the change event header.
steps.instruction: In the Line Items section, add a row for each change. Select the Budget Code, enter a Description, and enter the quantity and unit cost (and revenue values where applicable).
steps.title: Add cost line items

steps.expected: Supporting documents are attached to the change event.
steps.instruction: In the Attachments section, upload supporting files such as drawings, RFIs, or photos.
steps.title: Attach supporting documents

steps.expected: The completed draft is ready to save without creating demo data.
steps.instruction: Select Create Change Event to save. The change event is created in Open status, ready for pricing review and approval. Tutorial runs default to preview mode unless submitWorkflow is true.
steps.title: Save the change event
